principles: Any compatible model may perform any role or skill.
Select guardrails and autonomy from evidence; never assign a role by model name.
Unknown model configurations start with compatibility-strict and earn autonomy through evals.
Quality-critical work keeps strict verification and independent review regardless of model capability.

reference_compatibility_models.purpose: Reference compatibility target; not restricted to exploration and not a proven quality floor until measured.
Reference compatibility target; may perform any role under the selected execution profile.

compatibility-strict.purpose: Make any unqualified or lower-capability model reliable through bounded work and explicit verification.
constraints: One role, one skill, and one phase per run
Explicit task contract and fixed output contract
Bounded evidence search with UNKNOWN for missing inputs
Deterministic checks mapped to acceptance IDs

standard.purpose: Run a qualified model with normal phase-level autonomy while retaining role and verification boundaries.
constraints: Multiple bounded steps allowed within one phase
Exact skill output contract remains mandatory
Deterministic checks and independent review remain mandatory

high-autonomy.purpose: Allow a repeatedly qualified model to coordinate phases with explicit handoffs.
constraints: Preserve acceptance, evidence, trace, review, and promotion gates
Revoke on protected eval regression or excessive human correction

qualification.model_specific_prompt_forks: Only after a repeated, eval-proven incompatibility; prefer improving the shared skill first.

promotion_gates: Same task, context, skill version, tools, and graders for every candidate
No protected eval regression or new critical failure
Quality, completeness, latency, token, cost, and human-correction deltas reported
